state.background: B3e-c implements six separate nominal/real mobile tooltip-scroll Browser Mode cases in tests/browser-mode/SpendingBarChart-tooltip-scroll.browser.test.tsx at 375x667, 320x480, and 667x375. They mount actual SpendingBarChart and production CustomTooltip with the actual touch-mode useChartTooltipController, its chart handlers, normal controller activation, and no manual tooltip wrapper placement. Independent review confirms production expense key counts (21 nominal / 11 real), 84 deterministic quarters, and production-equivalent outer/chart parent widths. Exact source audit and Oracle review narrowed the original broader proposed transfer to six E2E assertions only: P42-246 computed overflowY, -247 positive maxHeight, -248 bottom padding, -250 scrollHeight>clientHeight, -255 scroll-to-end within 1px, and -256 close visibility after scrolling. Playwright retains P42-241–244, -251–254, and -257–261. P42-245 is unit-owned; P42-249 is absent from the current E2E and unit-owned. Focused Browser Mode passed 6/6. B3e-c adds 6 to 10/20, reaching 16/20; A=123/E=90/M=1 stays unchanged, rows remain partial, and no E2E was run.
acceptanceCriteria: Focused Browser Mode file tests/browser-mode/SpendingBarChart-tooltip-scroll.browser.test.tsx passes 6/6 across nominal and real cases at 375x667, 320x480, and 667x375.

The cases mount actual SpendingBarChart and production CustomTooltip using useChartTooltipController({suppressed:false,isTouch:true}), real chart event handlers, touch/click controller activation, and standard production tooltip placement; no manual wrapper placement or direct tooltip-state assignment is used.
Independent review confirms the fixtures use the production 21 nominal / 11 real expense keys, 84 quarters, and production-equivalent parent widths.

Only P42-246/-247/-248 computed overflowY/max-height/paddingBottom, P42-250 scrollHeight>clientHeight, P42-255 scroll-to-end within 1px, and P42-256 close visibility after scroll move from E2E to Browser Mode.

Playwright retains P42-241–244 route/visibility, actual touch/controller activation, and content/key mapping; P42-251–254 absolute tooltip viewport bounds; P42-257–260 close-button viewport bounds; and P42-261 after-close hidden behavior. P42-245 is already unit-owned; P42-249 has no current E2E assertion and remains unit-owned.

The broader original B3e-c proposal was narrowed after exact assertion audit and Oracle review to preserve absolute viewport-bound E2E guarantees. No retained E2E assertion is represented as transferred.
B3e-c adds six cases to the previous 10/20 cadence, reaching 16/20. No E2E was run. A=123/E=90/M=1 is unchanged and all three stable rows remain partial.
The preceding B3e-b checkpoint passed valid_as_defined (confidence .97, pass probability .98); its two earnings viewport candidates remain deferred and all P42-219–240 assertions stay in E2E.
